review_scope: Code and methodological review of both joint modules; full three-factor actual-data validation remains pending until all required exports exist.
mathematics_review: Pooled fixed common-support weights, direct risks, log-RR delta interval and RD variance are internally consistent. OtherHD reconstruction is valid for mutually exclusive principal diagnoses; missing inputs are not zero-imputed.
remaining_limitations: Fixed-weight binomial model intervals omit clustering, repeat admissions, coding uncertainty and residual confounding.
Two broad age bands leave within-band confounding.
PCCL is not an admission severity measure and may include downstream diagnoses.
Boundary/sparse cells retained but flagged; Wald/delta precision may be optimistic for rare strata.
